questions.stem: Which of the following is the primary source of energy for all ecosystems on Earth?
choices: Wind
Sun
Water
Soil
questions.solution: The sun is the primary source of energy for all ecosystems on Earth because it provides the light and heat necessary for photosynthesis, which supports the food chain. Wind, water, and soil do not generate energy on their own and are not the main sources that sustain ecosystems. Unlike the sun, they do not provide the initial energy input required for life processes.

questions.stem: What is the term used for organisms that break down complex organic matter into inorganic substances?
choices: Producers
Consumers
Decomposers
Detritivores
questions.solution: Decomposers are organisms that break down complex organic matter into simpler inorganic substances, which is essential for nutrient cycling in ecosystems. Producers create their own food through photosynthesis, consumers obtain energy by eating other organisms, and detritivores consume dead organic material but do not break it down into inorganic substances as decomposers do. The correct answer is decomposers.

hi.stem: जीव जो कठिन जैविक पदार्थों को अकार्बनिक पदार्थों में तोड़ देते हैं, के लिए क्या शब्द प्रयोग किया जाता है?

hi.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Hindi terminology used for biological concepts.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about the standing crop in an ecosystem?
choices: It is the total number of organisms in the ecosystem
It is the mass of living organisms at a particular trophic level
It is the amount of energy available at the top trophic level
It is the number of decomposers in the ecosystem
questions.solution: The correct statement is that standing crop is the mass of living organisms at a particular trophic level, as it refers to the biomass present at that specific level in the food chain. The first option is incorrect because it refers to the total number in the entire ecosystem, not a specific trophic level. The third option is wrong because it refers to energy, not biomass, and the fourth option is incorrect as it only considers decomposers, not all organisms at a trophic level.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about the biomass of a species?
choices: It is measured in terms of wet weight only
It is expressed in terms of dry weight for accuracy
It is the same for all species in an ecosystem
It is not affected by environmental conditions
questions.solution: Biomass is expressed in terms of dry weight for accuracy because it removes water content, which can vary and affect measurements. Wet weight alone is not used because it does not provide a consistent measure. Biomass differs among species and is influenced by environmental factors such as temperature and resource availability.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the role of decomposers in an ecosystem?
choices: They produce organic matter through photosynthesis
They consume other organisms for energy
They convert dead organic matter into simpler forms
They regulate the population of herbivores
questions.solution: Decomposers break down dead organic material, recycling nutrients back into the ecosystem. This process involves converting complex organic matter into simpler forms that can be reused by other organisms. The other options describe the roles of producers, consumers, and predators, which do not align with the function of decomposers.

questions.stem: In an ecosystem, the standing crop is measured as the mass of living organisms or the number in a unit area. Which of the following best describes the standing crop?
choices: The number of organisms in a given area at a particular time
The total biomass of all organisms in the ecosystem
The mass of dead organic matter in the ecosystem
The total energy available at a trophic level
questions.solution: The standing crop refers to the amount of living material present at a specific time in a given area. It can be measured in terms of biomass or number of organisms. The correct option directly states this definition. The other options are incorrect because they focus on specific components (producers, decomposers) or energy, which is not what standing crop refers to.

questions.stem: Based on the diagram of trophic levels in an ecosystem, which of the following is true about the transfer of energy?
choices: Energy increases as it moves up trophic levels
Energy is completely transferred from one trophic level to the next
Only 10% of energy is transferred from one trophic level to the next
Energy is transferred in a circular manner
questions.solution: Only 10% of energy is transferred from one trophic level to the next because most energy is lost as heat through metabolic processes. Energy decreases as it moves up trophic levels due to this loss, making the first option incorrect. Energy is not completely transferred, so the second option is false. Energy flows in a one-way direction, not in a circle, which makes the fourth option incorrect.

questions.stem: Why is the biomass pyramid in aquatic ecosystems often inverted?

questions.stem: Which of the following is the reason that the pyramid of energy is always upright?
choices: It accounts for all organisms at each trophic level
It is based on the 10% law of energy transfer
It includes decomposers in the pyramid
It is measured in terms of dry weight
questions.solution: The pyramid of energy is always upright because energy transfer between trophic levels is inefficient, with only about 10% of energy passing to the next level. This is why the second option is correct. The first option is incorrect because all pyramids account for organisms at each level. The third option is wrong because decomposers are not typically included in energy pyramids. The fourth option is incorrect as dry weight relates to biomass, not energy flow.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कारण है कि ऊर्जा के पिरामिड हमेशा ऊर्ध्वाधर होता है?
choices: इसमें प्रत्येक पोषी स्तर पर सभी जीवों को शामिल किया जाता है
इसके आधार पर ऊर्जा स्थानांतरण का 10% नियम है
इसमें पिरामिड में अपघटक शामिल होते हैं
इसे शुष्क भार के आधार पर मापा जाता है
hi.solution: ऊर्जा के पिरामिड हमेशा ऊर्ध्वाधर होता है क्योंकि पोषी स्तरों के बीच ऊर्जा स्थानांतरण अकुशल होता है, लगभग 10% ऊर्जा अगले स्तर तक पहुंचती है। इसलिए दूसरा विकल्प सही है। पहला विकल्प गलत है क्योंकि सभी पिरामिड प्रत्येक स्तर पर जीवों को शामिल करते हैं। तीसरा विकल्प गलत है क्योंकि अपघटक आमतौर पर ऊर्जा पिरामिड में शामिल नहीं होते हैं। चौथा विकल्प गलत है क्योंकि शुष्क भार जैवभार से संबंधित है, ऊर्जा प्रवाह से नहीं।
hi.imageAlt: एक आरेख जो पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में ऊर्जा प्रवाह को दर्शाता है, जिसमें एक बार मैग्नेट और एक तीर होता है जिसका लेबल 'ऊर्जा प्रवाह' होता है जो बाएं से दाएं की ओर इशारा करता है, और शीर्ष पर 'ऊर्जा पिरामिड' का लेखन होता है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology consistent with Indian biology textbooks.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते ऊर्जा पिरामिड सदैव उभे असते याचे कारण आहे?
choices: ते प्रत्येक ट्रॉफिक लेव्हलवरील सर्व जीव गणण्यासाठी आहे
ते ऊर्जा हस्तांतरणाच्या 10% नियमावर आधारित आहे
ते पिरामिडमध्ये विघटकांचा समावेश करते
ते शुष्क वजनाच्या दृष्टीने मोजले जाते
mr.solution: ऊर्जा पिरामिड सदैव उभे असते कारण ट्रॉफिक लेव्हलमधून ऊर्जा हस्तांतरण अक्षम असते, ज्यामुळे दुसऱ्या लेव्हलमध्ये ऊर्जेच्या जवळपास 10% पर्यंत पोहोचते. हे कारण दुसरा विकल्प बरोबर आहे. पहिला विकल्प चूक आहे कारण सर्व पिरामिड प्रत्येक लेव्हलवरील जीव गणतात. तिसरा विकल्प चूक आहे कारण विघटकांचा समावेश ऊर्जा पिरामिडमध्ये सामान्यतः केला जात नाही. चौथा विकल्प चूक आहे कारण शुष्क वजन जैवद्रव्याशी संबंधित आहे, ऊर्जा प्रवाहाशी नाही.
mr.imageAlt: एक आकृती जी एका पर्यावरणात ऊर्जा प्रवाह दर्शवते, ज्यामध्ये एक बार मॅग्नेट आणि एक तीर जो बाजूने बाजूला 'ऊर्जा प्रवाह' लेबल केलेला आहे, आणि शीर्षस्थानी 'ऊर्जा पिरामिड' असे लिहिले आहे.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi terminology for ecological concepts.

questions.stem: In an ecosystem, a single organism can occupy more than one trophic level. Which of the following scenarios best illustrates this concept?
choices: A sparrow eating seeds and insects
A tiger preying on a deer
A mushroom breaking down dead trees
A cow grazing on grass
questions.solution: A sparrow can act as a primary consumer when it eats seeds and as a secondary consumer when it eats insects, showing that one organism can occupy more than one trophic level. The other options describe typical roles of organisms in an ecosystem but do not illustrate the concept of occupying multiple trophic levels.

hi.stem: एक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में, एक जीव एक से अधिक पोषी स्तर ले सकता है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा परिदृश्य इस अवधारणा को सबसे अच्छा दर्शाता है?

एक कांटा मृत पेड़ के अपघटन में लगा हुआ है
एक गाय घास चरती है
